recognition_cue: One clear elastic strand with a slow gather and a few trapped bubbles.
visual_meaning: A tactile category cue for filtered snail secretion; not a molecule, extraction record, or finished formula.

motion_contract.entrance: Reveal the strand from lower left to upper right while the anchor gathers into place.
motion_contract.ambient: Use one shallow vertical breath or highlight travel; the actor should feel viscous, not bouncy.
motion_contract.resolve: Let the lower strand settle and hold before text or evidence resolves.
host_rules: Animate spatial motion with GSAP transform aliases.
Use a mask or stroke-dash reveal only on the strand wrapper.
Never use elastic or bounce easing.
Keep all motion finite and owned by the host timeline.

chapter_open.purpose: Introduce the filtrate as the continuing subject, separate from any product.

continuity_anchor.purpose: Keep the elastic-strand identity present during process or formula explanation.

diagram_node.purpose: Connect the ingredient to a vehicle or process without depicting the whole formula.

evidence_companion.purpose: Remain recognizable beside evidence while yielding visual hierarchy.

recap_token.purpose: Close the story with the same strand silhouette used at entry.

unknown_version.purpose: Flag an unspecified filtrate, collection method or formula context.

reentry.first_appearance: Use the complete strand draw and restrained gather once.
reentry.later_appearances: Return from the previous endpoint with a brief settle; do not replay the full draw.
reentry.chapter_return: Keep the strand direction and bubble placement stable across contexts.

recognition_tests.small_size_mode: Keep the main elastic curve, anchor and one bubble; suppress secondary highlights.

disclosure: Illustrative ingredient actor. Exact composition, collection method and formula performance are product-specific.
